asset_compaction.method: Only records never referenced by any of the 541 frames are omitted from board ROMs. Original geometry and editable Blender model remain complete.

interpolation_quality.allocation: Minimax dynamic programming over integer frame intervals, preserving all authored controls and dense transition frames
interpolation_quality.metric: Screen-space L2 error of group object-space bounding-box corners under quantized direct MVP versus RTL coefficient interpolation; conservative sample geometry, not a source-video score.

matrix_sampling.excluded_motion_field: limb_target_keys: dense measurement targets, evaluated by the source motion fitter before matrix sampling

rendering: Existing MGPU receives three-dimensional object coordinates and a group-specific MVP; pixel rasterization and framebuffer writes are RTL.
order_limit: 26 painter caches are fitted to projected-overlap dependencies, with at most 131072 entries. Every potentially visible face is retained. Remaining cyclic constraints and per-frame geometric coverage errors are recorded in ordering_report.json.
